explain.NewHeight: The remaining scheduled wait before starting the next height. Commit processing has already used part of that schedule.
explain.NewRound: Round setup. A height can require more than one round, so visits per block need not equal one.
explain.Propose: The local proposal phase, including waiting for a proposal. This is not a direct measurement of network transport alone.
explain.Prevote: The first voting phase. The node evaluates the proposal and participates in collecting voting power.
explain.Precommit: The second voting phase. A sufficient precommit quorum allows the node to commit the block.
explain.Commit: The local Commit state includes application execution and persistence. It is not just a vote message.
explain.PrevoteWait: A conditional wait state. An absent series is unavailable, while an observed zero delta means no recorded contribution in this window.
explain.PrecommitWait: A conditional wait state. An absent series is unavailable, while an observed zero delta means no recorded contribution in this window.
